name: Pointe du Hoc
text: La Pointe du Hoc (French pronunciation: [pwɛ̃t dy ɔk]) is a promontory with a 35-metre (110 ft) cliff overlooking the English Channel on the northwestern coast of Normandy in the Calvados department, France. In World War II, Pointe du Hoc was the location of a series of German bunkers and machine gun posts. Prior to the invasion of Normandy, the German army fortified the area with concrete casemates and gun pits.

depictions.name: Pointe du Hoc
depictions.text: featured Pointe du Hoc is a cliff located in Normandy which was invaded by the Allies during World War II. It appears in Call of Duty 2 and Call of Duty: WWII
